decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, as shown on drawing numbers 091/P/001, 002, 003 received 06th February 2006, and 091/P/004A received 30th March 2006, is recommended for approval as it is considered that the extensions, by reason of their size, materials, design and location would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of the ground floor flat, 37 Arlington Gardens, Chiswick. The extensions would not be detrimental to the surrounding properties. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and satisfactorily complies with Councils residential Extension Guidelines, and would preserve the character of the Turnham Green Conservation Area.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and installation of side extension to create entrance porch for ground floor flat
